00b3d2a0.mechanics: A six-byte no-argument accessor that loads DAT_0167eae4 into EAX and returns. It has no callee, allocation, lock, or write.

00b3d2a0.decision: The root is not the identity-lookup algorithm. It supplies the receiver/context consumed by 00ba9370, whose map lookup uses cStarManager+0x150 and +0x154. A second direct bridge loads DAT_0167eae4 into ECX and reads +0x204, matching cStarManager::mpRelationshipManager in the SDK field map. Therefore the root is best classified as a cached manager/registry owner, not as the empire registry map itself.

Selected callers do not directly dereference the 0x00b3d300 return as a vtable or field before forwarding it; the downstream owner helpers return the actual domain objects.
The root is used with unrelated state domains, including player data, object/noun lookup, game mode, and tool/beam behavior, which supports a shared simulator context boundary.
The frozen interface reports discarded returns in some callers; therefore no universal non-null or must-use contract is established.
The return is normally moved into ECX and passed as the receiver to 00ba9370, which performs the empire-registry lower-bound lookup.
The root itself never receives the pushed ID argument; pushed values near call sites belong to 00ba9370 or later helpers.
The returned object is used as a manager receiver by multiple independent operations, not as a scalar ID or a bare map handle.
The +0x150 and +0x204 offsets are compatible with the SDK cStarManager layout, but the slot is not the same global as the SDK-declared cStarManager::Get slot.
